name: sgs/label
title: Label
description: Atomic eyebrow / kicker / badge text block. A BLOCK-LEVEL element by contract (renders display:block/inline-block, never a bare inline span), so vertical margins and box padding always paint. Three style variants: plain text, full-width pill fill, content-width pill wrap. Reusable for section eyebrows, card-tag badges, and intro labels.

label.label: Label
label._note: Single-semantic-element block — the <span> root IS the wrapper (render.php:63, block-level element by contract). `padding` support is declared `false` (spacing.padding=false) — padding is instead the SGS custom object attr `padding` (pill-gated, base + paddingTablet/paddingMobile tiers), not native. No __experimentalBorder support — border-radius is the scalar `borderRadius` attr, and the border is `borderWidth`, `borderStyle`, `borderColour` and `borderColourGradient`, edited with SgsBorderControl. With an end shape (`endShapeLeft`, `endShapeRight`, `endDepth`) the root's border only reserves room and is transparent, and the outline is drawn by the first-child `.sgs-label__edge` element (includes/helpers-end-shape.php). No box-shadow, no width/height/aspect-ratio attrs — honest gaps (`css:gap` is dotGap, the leading dot's space to the text); label is a small text chip with no image surface beyond `background-color`, which now lives on its own `background` element below (2026-08-22, text/background pseudo-element split) rather than sharing this element — `css:color`'s `background-clip:text` gradient mode would otherwise overwrite/clip a background painted on the SAME node.

background.label: Background
background._note: The block's own background paint, moved off the `label` element onto a `::after` pseudo-element layer (render.php) so a text gradient on the SAME root node (`label` element's `css:color-gradient`) cannot clip or overwrite it via `background-clip:text`. GRADIENT SIBLING (colour-conformance FILL closeout, 2026-09-06): backgroundColourGradient added — the block already calls the shared sgs_block_background_layer_css()/sgs_background_paint_decl() mechanism, it just hardcoded the gradient argument to '' instead of reading a real attribute. No hover sibling — a static decorative label has no :hover CSS anywhere on this block.

dot.label: Dot
dot._note: The opt-in leading dot (`dot`), painted as a decorative `::before` on the label root (render.php): an empty `content`, so the label text stays the accessible text. dotGap (on the label element) is its margin-inline-end to the text.

linkUnderline.description: How a link inside the label is underlined: '' the theme's underline, none, always, hover (an underline on hover and keyboard focus), or sweep (a line sweeps in on hover and keyboard focus). sgs_link_underline_css().

linkUnderlineThickness.description: Thickness of the link underline for always, hover and sweep (a CSS length); empty uses the theme's link-sweep thickness or the browser's.

linkUnderlineColour.description: The link underline's colour for always, hover and sweep (a palette slug or any CSS colour); empty draws it in the link's own colour. sgs_link_underline_css().

linkUnderlineColourHover.description: The link underline's colour while the link is hovered or focused with the keyboard (a palette slug or any CSS colour); empty keeps the colour it has at rest. sgs_link_underline_css().

linkUnderlineOffset.description: Gap between the link text and its underline for always and hover (a CSS length); empty uses the browser's. The sweep is a background line, so it ignores the gap. sgs_link_underline_css().

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the label text with a masked-glyph gradient instead of a flat colour (D636 shape). Non-empty wins over textColour at render time.

textColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of textColourHover. Non-empty wins over textColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

backgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the label's background via background-image, on the ::after layer sgs_block_background_layer_css() already builds (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06). Non-empty wins over backgroundColour.

borderRadius.description: Border radius as a CSS length (e.g. '16px', '1.5rem'). A bare number is treated as px for pre-2026-08-13 instances.

endShapeLeft.description: Shape cut into the left end of the label, from the shape-divider library: '' is Straight, arrow a V notch, triangle a point, slant, curve (round), wave-smooth, zigzag. Whatever is behind the label shows through the cut.

endShapeRight.description: Shape cut into the right end of the label; the same values as endShapeLeft.

endDepth.description: How far an end shape reaches into the label, as a percentage of the label's height, so the angle holds at any text length.

borderWidth.description: Border width as a { top, right, bottom, left } box of CSS lengths. With an end shape the outline follows the cut; its stroke needs the top width in px.

borderStyle.description: Border style; empty paints solid beside a width, none draws no border.

borderColour.description: Border colour (palette slug or CSS colour).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient painting the border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColour.

dot.description: Show a small decorative dot before the label text (a ::before on the label, never part of its accessible text).

dotColour.description: Dot colour (palette slug or CSS colour). Empty follows the label's text colour (currentColor).

dotColourGradient.description: CSS gradient painting the dot instead of a flat colour (sgs_background_paint_decl()). Non-empty wins over dotColour.

dotSize.description: Dot diameter as a CSS length; empty uses 7px.

dotGap.description: Space between the dot and the text: a CSS length (default 8px) or a spacing preset slug (e.g. '20'), read through sgs_css_length_value(); empty uses 8px.
